name: Okaa-san to Koubi ~Tojikomerarete Futarikkiri Sekai ni Nattara Hoka ni Nani Suru?~
original_name: お母さんと交尾 ～閉じ込められて二人っきり世界になったら他に何する？～
source:
The gentle and beautiful mother, Chizuru, and her devoted son, the protagonist. But their happy family of two was shattered on the day a once-in-50-years typhoon struck.

Trapped inside their house by a landslide, the two joined forces, encouraging each other as they waited for rescue. But when the protagonist spies his mother masturbating in the bathroom, driven by animalistic desire, they engage in a forbidden relationship...

At first, both mother and son were tormented by guilt over their transgression, but gradually they could no longer resist the pleasure of their forbidden act, drowning in the illicit pleasure between mother and son.

“From morning till night, anywhere and everywhere, mother and son repeated their forbidden sex, greedily devouring each other's pleasure...”

山体滑坡将两人困在家中，他们互相鼓励、携手合作，等待救援。然而，当主人公看见母亲在浴室里被兽性欲望驱使着自慰时，两人跨越了禁忌的关系……
